rows.name: history-0-typed
rows.usefulPrefix: CUDA groups threads into warps of 32 so the GPU can issue one instruction to many threads at once, rather than control each thread independently. When threads in a warp take different branches, the GPU executes the required paths with only the appropriate threads active, then reconverges them. That’s why branch divergence can reduce performance; the exact width of 32 is NVIDIA’s architectural choice, not a fundamental requirement.
